_note: All sources accessed 2026-10-13 from the Claude Code environment. Direct fetches of sec.gov, signetjewelers.com and q4cdn.com were blocked by the environment's network policy, so figures were extracted from web-search result excerpts of those documents and of their verbatim re-publications (Business Wire, Nasdaq, Morningstar, StreetInsider). Every figure is tagged with a confidence flag in the CSV files: A = quoted verbatim from the primary document excerpt; B = from a verbatim re-publication or a second-hand summary of the primary document; C = derived by arithmetic from A/B figures; D = team estimate / allocation (documented in the Assumptions & Sources tab).
